description:
A Nikke in the Central Government who is tasked with managing the Ark's clandestine agreements.
Very few people know of her existence, and even her squad is shrouded in secrecy. Firmly believing that the world will one day grow to be truly kind, she thinks of everyone around her as children, and always cares for them with a gentle smile.

lines.text: My name is Snow Crane. I'm from the Veiled Order Squad. If you've never heard of us, that is only natural. We're meant to remain hidden behind a veil of secrecy.
I'm here because I wanted to meet you, Friend. Now that I have, I must say that you are wonderful, kind, and adorable.
If anything is weighing on you, no matter what it is, you can talk to me about it. I'm always happy to lend an ear.
Promises are important. You mustn't become like the naughty children who don't keep them. Got it?
Now that I've gotten to know you, you're far more thoughtful and splendid than I had heard. I'm very proud of you, Friend.
I hope that one day we can live in a world of peace, where no one fights. If there's anyone who can make that a reality, it's you, Friend.
Promising to meet me and then disappearing...? Hmm... It sounds like I might have to make someone read the Ten Virtues of Good Children.
It seems it's another busy day for you. You're always working so hard. It's very commendable. I think I'm going to give you a treat when you get back.
So this is the Outpost now... It used to be so barren, but it's become so lovely. It's quite amazing!
This place is peaceful only because you've worked so hard for it, right? You truly are remarkable, Friend.
Hmm... I just need to stay at the courthouse, yes? Hehe, I wonder what kind of friends I'll meet there...
Hello, Friend. Are you willing to enter an agreement to only use my power for good? I promise to never betray you.
Wow, what's this? You're really something, Friend.
Now that I'm even stronger, I can help you even more.
Oh, that is so nice of you. You must've worked so hard for that.
All of this... for me? Thank you.
You brought all of this just for me? You're too kind. You deserve a treat.
Next time, I want you to tell me something you want. I'll be sure to get it for you.
I feel like you'll keep any promise you make. It's something I really appreciate about you.
I want you to continue to be kind, wonderful, and endearing. Got it?
Thank you for working so hard for a kinder world. As a reward, you get a perfect score! 100 out of 100!
Thank you for calling for me.
Yes, Friend?
All right, I'll head right over.
Would you like me to scold these children?
Don't worry, Friend. I won't let you get hurt.
These children are in need of a lesson.
Let's help make the world a kinder place.
I need just a short break.
Are you doing okay? Not too tired?
One moment, please.
Are you ready?
A gold star for you, Friend!
Let's all give it just a little more oomph!
Onto the next one!
There's still more left.
For a kinder world...
Agh.
Ngh.
Ouch...
I'm sorry, Friend. I think... I need to rest...
Hehe, this was all thanks to your splendid leadership, Friend.
